title: JSX and React prop spreads hid remote resource requests from registry isolation

examples: where props is an unresolved parameter
React.createElement('img', { ...props }) where props is an unresolved parameter
reproduction.beforeFix: Static probes and a red regression showed pass for external asset URLs hidden in JSX spread attributes, React factory spread props, unresolved runtime prop spreads, and a spread descriptor passed to Object.defineProperty.
reproduction.afterFix: The source scan recursively resolves static object spreads and aliases in JSX attributes, React factory props, and property descriptors. It rejects statically remote URLs and fails closed when an unresolved spread can supply a URL to an automatically loading resource element.

rootCause: The JSX visitor skipped JsxSpreadAttribute nodes, and React factory/property descriptor resolution only read direct object properties. The shared resolver did not follow SpreadAssignment values or treat an unknown spread as an uncertified network-loading attribute.
remediation: Resolve object-literal properties through spreads and const aliases for JSX, React factory props, and DOM property descriptors. Fail closed on an unknown spread for an automatically loading resource tag; retain external links and user-submitted form controls under their existing behavior and CSP controls.
